# Version 4.154.0 (Unreleased)
> **Documentation delivery improvements**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.154.0 improves consumer API documentation delivery and keeps the bundled renderer current with Chrome m154. Package XML documentation now travels with managed assemblies, while generated bindings and HarfBuzzSharp metadata remain aligned with the bundled native sources.

## Breaking Changes

- **HarfBuzz combining-class enum name corrected** — UnicodeCombiningClass.CCC133 has been renamed to CCC132 to match HarfBuzz. Replace the old member name in source code. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))
- **GlyphFlags.Defined removed** — The aggregate GlyphFlags.Defined mask is no longer exposed. Combine the concrete flags your code needs instead. ([#5057](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5057))

## Engine

- **Chrome m154 fixes merged** — The pending release incorporates the latest upstream m154 renderer fixes. ([#5054](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5054))

## API Surface

- **API documentation ships with packages** — Managed package assemblies now include compiler-generated XML documentation sidecars for IDE consumers. ([#5064](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5064), [#5066](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5066), [#5078](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5078), [#5080](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5080))
